acceptance: fixed current-profile source and tokens.access_token semantics are source-grounded
public entrypoint has zero arguments and rejects without separate exact live grant/review before credential read
strict parser rejects duplicate keys, malformed JSON, nonfinite values, missing token and unknown top-level fields
raw and parsed credential strings remain mutable and are wiped synchronously
transient_bearer_scope consumes the token and DirectCatalogExecutor executes exactly once with raw custody enabled
raw catalog, membership receipt and execution receipt use full-write/file-fsync/no-replace/parent-fsync/reopen-hash; commit marker is last
uncertainty fences UNKNOWN and performs no retry/replay/auth recovery/status query
provider-free tests cover source attacks, writes, crashes, exception graphs, second execution and cleanup
falsifiers: any actual credential content read during implementation or tests
token bytes in argument, environment, output, log, receipt, exception graph or disk
source pin or binary identity mismatch
